sentences.japanese: リスは枝の中に隠れた。
sentences.english: A squirrel hid among the branches.

sentences.japanese: ランプが木の枝から吊り下げられた。
sentences.english: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.

sentences.japanese: パティは背が低くてその枝に手が届かなかった。
sentences.english: Patty was so short that she couldn't get at the branch.

sentences.japanese: たくさんの鳥が枝にとまっている。
sentences.english: Many birds are on the branch.

sentences.japanese: その木は広く枝を四方に張り出している。
sentences.english: The tree thrusts its branches far and wide.
